name: TWL
recent: TWL Holdings 于11月16日签署买卖协议，以2600万令吉向关联公司 TWL Capital Berhad 收购 Wisma TWL 九层商办大楼，属关联方交易。公司同时将于12月8日召开特别股东大会，寻求股东批准向执行主席配偶 Datin Sek Chian Nee 追认授予合共1.197亿股 ESOS 期权。此外，RCULS 转换持续进行，11月24日将有45万股新股上市。
notable: 以2600万令吉向关联公司 TWL Capital Berhad 收购 Wisma TWL 九层商办大楼。
将于12月8日召开特别股东大会，寻求追认向执行主席配偶授予合共1.197亿股 ESOS 期权。
RCULS 转换发行45万股新股，将于11月24日上市。
risks: 收购 Wisma TWL 属关联方交易，卖方 TWL Capital Berhad 与执行主席 Dato' Tan Wei Lian 有关联。
向执行主席配偶授予的1.197亿股 ESOS 期权是在未事先取得股东批准的情况下发出，现寻求追认。
近期有多份大股东及董事持股变动申报。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收6269万令吉，环比增长192.6%，同比增长205.4%；净利183万令吉，环比下降49.8%，同比下降92.3%；净利率2.9%，低于上一季度的17.0%。

recent_en: TWL Holdings signed a sale and purchase agreement on 16 November to acquire the nine-storey Wisma TWL office building from related party TWL Capital Berhad for RM26 million. RCULS conversions continue, with 450,000 new shares to be listed on 24 November.
notable_en: Acquiring the nine-storey Wisma TWL office building from related party TWL Capital Berhad for RM26 million.
Convening an EGM on 8 December to seek ratification of the grant of a total of 119.7 million ESOS options to the executive chairman's spouse.
Issuing 450,000 new shares from RCULS conversion, to be listed on 24 November.
risks_en: The Wisma TWL acquisition is a related-party transaction, with vendor TWL Capital Berhad connected to Executive Chairman Dato' Tan Wei Lian.
The 119.7 million ESOS options granted to the executive chairman's spouse were issued without prior shareholder approval and are now being ratified.
There have been multiple recent notifications of changes in substantial shareholders' and directors' interests.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM62.69 million, up 192.6% QoQ and 205.4% YoY; net income was RM1.83 million, down 49.8% QoQ and 92.3% YoY; net margin was 2.9%, lower than 17.0% in the previous quarter.
